headline: Local Stew Delivery Guy Stirs Pot, Declares Pizza a Culinary Faux Pas
deck: Town Council Faces Stew Showdown Amidst Culinary Chaos This Side of the Mississippi
article:
In a remarkable display of gastronomic defiance, Carl 'The Ladle' Jenkins, the town's leading stew delivery guru, has drawn a line in the broth over the glaring absence of pizza from American culture. Jenkins, a self-proclaimed 'stew philosopher,' insists that stew is 'the soul of America' — a claim he solidified in his self-published tome, 'Stew: The Unquestionable Culinary Apex.' This week, Jenkins has escalated his commitment to stew, prompting the town council to consider a ban on all non-stew-related foods to preserve local culinary integrity.

The council meeting last night was nothing short of theatrical, with Councilwoman Mabel Tumpkins exclaiming, "If we allow salad rights, what’s next? A fruit revolt?" Meanwhile, the newly formed Stew Appreciation Society has been rating new stew flavors with an intensity usually reserved for tax audits, leaving residents unsure if they were attending a culinary critique or a financial seminar.

In a twist of culinary rebellion, a rogue group of locals is advocating for 'salad rights,' citing the nutritional virtues of leafy greens. Jenkins, unfazed, declared, "Salad is merely a garnish for real nourishment. This is about honor and tradition, folks!" As tensions simmer, residents face the daunting task of defending their beloved stew against an unpredictable array of rogue vegetables encroaching on their culinary sanctuary.

As Friday night stew night approaches, one can only ponder whether this bizarre clash will finally lead Jenkins to confront an unthinkable truth: that the world might just need more than stew.
author: Milton P. Gobbler, Culinary Correspondent

oped.title: Stew for Thought: A Culinary Conspiracy of Hat-Wearing Pizza Purists
oped.author: Sir W. A. Noodle, Esq., Culinary Inquisitor and Unlicensed Taste Consultant
oped.body: Ah, dear readers of the Multiverse Gazette! Can we take a moment to dissect the absurdity of a world where our illustrious stew delivery man, Bob ‘The Broth’ Butterfield, is vilified for daring to serve the beloved potage without the shadow of pizza looming over it? This is a travesty! Town Council, ban stew? Absurd! Let them don their jaunty hats of rebellion instead. Those hats, I posit, are the true culprits behind the cultural absence of pizza; who can even think about toppings when distracted by such flamboyance? I propose a far more egregious solution: mandatory pizza costumes for all stew aficionados! Let’s reclaim our Fridays, people! For in the kingdom of culinary delights, let us not be swallowed whole by the tyranny of toppings—be it stew or the fanciful fabric of our hats! Long live stew night!

classifieds.text: Stew Pot of Controversy: 50-gallon stainless steel stew pot. Used only for award-winning Friday night stew. Comes with a spatula and my 'Stew is Life' bumper sticker. Price: $200 or best offer—serious inquiries only!

Wanted: Stew taste testers for local stew delivery service. Must have a discerning palate, a love for all things stew, and a firm stance against pizza. Pay includes free stew and a hat that says 'No Pizza Zone!'

Lost: One confidence. Last seen at the Town Council meeting where stew was unfairly compared to pizza not once, but twice! If found, please return to owner for a bowl of the finest stew and a heartfelt apology.
Attention citizens! Due to recent culinary debates, we will be holding an emergency stew summit this Saturday. Bring your best ladle and prepare to defend your broth. Pizza haters welcome!

stories.headline: Local Stew Subscription Service Sees 300% Growth Amid Pizza Void
stories.deck: Stew futures are now more unpredictable than ever.
stories.article:
In a surprising twist of culinary fate, Stewly Delicious, a local stew subscription service, reports a staggering 300% growth this quarter. With pizza no longer distracting consumers, discerning palates have turned their attention to classic broth-based dishes, leading to a surge in orders for the artisanal 'Three-Meat Extravaganza' stew.

Experts predict that this shift may forever alter the local economy, with CEO Gus Slurp vowing to revolutionize the stew delivery industry, including plans for a 'Stew-Cycle' delivery service. However, analysts warn that the New England Chowder Coalition is preparing a counteroffer, threatening to spark a mergers-and-acquisitions frenzy that could lead to the 'Great Stew War of 2026.'

stories.headline: Annual Stew Festival Features Unprecedented Broth Comedy Contest
stories.deck: Ladle joke-tellers vie for the coveted Silver Spoon.
stories.article:
The 42nd Annual Stew Festival kicked off this weekend, with participants showcasing their best ladle-wielding humor in the inaugural Broth Comedy Contest. Contestants raised the stakes by inventing absurd puns like 'You can’t be a stew in this town without a ladle of laughter!' Judges were left bewildered, with only one comic managing to earn applause for their clever stew-themed haiku.

This year's festival has drawn critiques from the National Association of Unfunny Stew Jokes, who argue that the event has undermined the seriousness of stew culture. In a statement, spokesperson Pota Tater claimed, 'It’s about soup, not laughs!' They might want to reconsider their career path, as audience members reportedly left the venue in tears—not from laughter, but from the realization of their wasted time.

stories.headline: Stew-Nappers Strike Again, Targeting Famed Local Recipe
stories.deck: Investigators suspect a cartel of rogue chefs is behind the trend.
stories.article:
In a troubling trend, local law enforcement has reported a surge in stew-related thefts, with the prized 'Grandma’s Celery Delight' recipe allegedly stolen last Saturday. Investigators believe a sophisticated network of stew-nappers may be behind the heist, with suspects rumored to be operating out of abandoned diners.

Detective Clara Ladle stated, 'This is more than just a simple theft; it’s an affront to culinary heritage.' Authorities have warned all stew enthusiasts to guard their cookbooks closely, as the black market for secret recipes heats up faster than a pot on a summer stovetop. Rumors suggest a sell-out event for a clandestine stew recipe auction could be in the works, leading to a culinary showdown unlike any the suburbs have ever seen.
